a screen leaves SAMPLE_STATE when it renders a real query or the house <x-ui.empty-state> on a real authenticated GET, and the same commit that deletes its banner adds its OwnerNav entry — the three assertions interlock so a screen can never be half-released (R245)

an empty state on a screen whose table has no writer carries no action and no href, and the module files an UNRESOLVED naming the missing writer
a screen is not asked for a nav entry unless it opts into the owner layout, so the reachability check's population is the work already done; the census is the number that check cannot produce.
a table's column is not measured until its distribution is stated; a column constant across every row is a defect to report, not a result to ship
a value derived from a name is a guess wearing a measurement's formatting; a column's histogram proves its detector fired, not that it fired on the right question
an owner screen whose own view carries a visible h1 does not opt into the layout's sr-only heading seam; the shell assertion is the proof obligation, the sr-only line is a check on the seam
an owner screen gets its single h1 from its own view or from the layout's sr-only seam and never from both; the count is the invariant and the source of it is free

the reachability check's population is the work already done, so the count of tenant.role routes it cannot see is pinned as a measurement that reds in both directions; a pinned count excuses no route and is not an exclusion

the sample-state module attribute is generated from the master plan's prose and renders it to owners; the leak is the generator's to fix and this lane's to count, so its size is pinned as a measurement that reds when it grows and when it is repaired

a partition assertion whose total is incremented in the same loop as its parts is an identity and cannot fail; a total is load-bearing only when derived independently of the partition it checks, and a test's failure message states what was measured and the limit of it, never a fact about routes nobody mapped

a pinned count cannot rot but prose attached to it rots as fast as any other prose while borrowing the pin's credibility; a failure message states what the code measured and what it did not measure, never a fact about the world the code does not check

a pinned count states what a red means in each direction or the next reader lowers it instead of fixing the code; and a backlog count is not scoped until it is split by whether the thing behind it exists
a corroboration must use a different derivation and not the same literal run in a second program; a partition whose largest bucket equals the population it partitions has not partitioned anything

a component's mount() existing is not the same as it resolving the tenant, so a census column that records the method is true and cannot scope the work; and a bucket named for a state it does not measure is an upper bound on that state, never a count of it

a rendered-HTML check cannot see a branch no test renders, so the heading contract the layout seam creates is measured at the blade's text and not at the response body; and a screen's populated branch is unproven by every shell test in this lane

a conditional that increments a counter in only one arm leaves the other arm counted nowhere, so every branch of a partitioning check gets a bucket even when the bucket is empty; and a blade with no heading at all is a defect only for a component the layout seam does not serve

a check that reads the first match of a repeating pattern has measured one element and not the sequence, so a heading contract is judged over every heading a view emits and not the first one; and a pin whose value moves is committed at the value it is observed to have before the fix that moves it

a check that flattens a branching document into one linear sequence has measured a document that is never rendered, so the check states that limit in its own failure message and the size of the population it could be wrong about is pinned as an upper bound rather than left unstated. --ruling R245

a counter that ignores conditional keywords measures an upper bound only over the vocabulary it does track, so the population containing those uncounted keywords is pinned to detect drift, and its failure message states what a red means in both directions and that neither is by itself a defect

derive the untracked block-opener vocabulary from the population instead of using a keyword literal, limiting the check to openers whose closer also appears in this population

a count pin is blind to a vocabulary swap so the set is pinned as a string instead, and a block construct emitting its body in document order cannot weaken the heading depth upper bound so its arrival is not by itself a defect

a check whose scope covers a fraction of the population its title names pins the size of the unwalked fraction, so that a later wave can widen the scope against an existing number without moving multiple pins at once --ruling R245

--ruling R245 apply the owner-layout heading contract to the unwalked components alongside with its own pins, leaving the glob and all eleven existing pins untouched, and folding the missing view and missing heading checks fail-closed into a single pin to prevent uncounted state.
